newsitem.title: USA: Tobacco stocks ignite blue-chip market.
newsitem.headline: Tobacco stocks ignite blue-chip market.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks extended into a third session their bounce from last week's sell-off as Wall Street got a lift Wednesday from a surge in tobacco stocks sparked by news of industry talks to settle lawsuits.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 92.71 points, or 1.41 percent, at 6,679.87 after gaining nearly 196 points since Monday.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 13-10 on active volume of 496 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
